series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2024, 40% of consumers will trick behavior tracking metrics to intentionally devalue the personal data collected about them, making it difficult to monetize.
entries.subject: Consumer obfuscation of behavior tracking
entries.metric: share of consumers tricking behavior tracking metrics

entries.quote: By 2024, 30% of corporate teams will be without a boss due to the self-directed and hybrid nature of work.
entries.subject: Bossless teams
entries.metric: share of corporate teams without a boss

entries.quote: By 2025, synthetic data will reduce personal customer data collection, avoiding 70% of privacy violation sanctions.
entries.subject: Synthetic data and privacy
entries.metric: share of privacy violation sanctions avoided

entries.quote: By 2024, a cyberattack will so damage critical infrastructure that a member of the G20 will reciprocate with a declared physical attack.
entries.subject: Cyberattack leading to physical retaliation

entries.quote: By 2024, 80% of CIOs surveyed will list modular business redesign, through composability, as a top 5 reason for accelerated business performance.
entries.subject: Composable business
entries.metric: share of surveyed CIOs listing modular business redesign as a top-5 reason for performance

entries.quote: By 2025, 75% of companies will “break up” with poor-fit customers as the cost of retaining them eclipses good-fit customer acquisition costs.
entries.subject: Dropping poor-fit customers
entries.metric: share of companies breaking up with poor-fit customers

entries.quote: Through 2026, a 30% increase in developer talent across Africa will help transform it into a world-leading startup ecosystem, rivaling Asia in venture fund growth.
entries.subject: African developer talent
entries.metric: increase in developer talent across Africa

entries.quote: By 2026, non-fungible token (NFT) gamification will propel an enterprise into the top 10 highest valued companies.
entries.subject: NFT gamification
entries.note: An enterprise enters the top 10 highest valued companies via NFT gamification.

entries.quote: By 2027, low orbit satellites will extend internet coverage to an additional billion of the world’s poorest people, raising 50% of them out of poverty.
entries.subject: Low Earth orbit satellite internet
entries.note: Also: raising 50% of them out of poverty.

entries.quote: By 2027, a quarter of the Fortune 20 companies will be supplanted by companies that neuromine and influence subconscious behavior at scale.
entries.subject: Neuromining of subconscious behavior

notes: Edition covers '2022 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions. gartner.com returns 403 to scripted fetches; text read from the Internet Archive snapshot listed in sources. The press release also states a supporting prediction under the NFT item (by 2024, 50% of publicly listed companies with an NFT underpinning their brand). Not captured as a top prediction. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
